cypher: MATCH (n:question) RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (n:question|criterion) RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (n {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'}) RETURN n.title AS title
MATCH (a)-[:blocks]->(b {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'}) RETURN a.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (d {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'})<-[:blocks]-(a) RETURN a.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (d {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D2'})-[:conflicts_with]-(x) RETURN x.id AS id
MATCH (o {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000N1'})-[r:supports|undercuts]->(d) RETURN label(r) AS rel, d.id AS id, r.confidence AS c ORDER BY rel, id
MATCH (o {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000N1'})--(n) RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS edges ORDER BY id
MATCH (c {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000C1'})-[:undercuts]-(x) RETURN x.id AS id, count(*) AS n
MATCH (a {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000N2'})-[r:undercuts]->(b) RETURN r.id AS id, label(r) AS rel, r.confidence AS c, b.id AS dst
MATCH (n)-[r]-() RETURN n.id AS id, count(r) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC, id LIMIT 3
MATCH (a {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'})-[:depends_on*1..4]->(t) RETURN t.id AS id, count(*) AS paths ORDER BY id
MATCH (a {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000Q1'})-[:blocks*2..2]->(t) RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (a)-[:blocks]->(d:decision), (d)-[:depends_on]->(e) RETURN a.id AS a_id, d.id AS d_id, e.id AS e_id ORDER BY a_id, d_id
MATCH (a {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'})-[:conflicts_with]-(b)-[:conflicts_with]-(c) RETURN c.id AS id
MATCH (n) WHERE n.likelihood >= 3 OR (n.status = 'contested' AND NOT n.title STARTS WITH 'Vendor') RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (q:question) WHERE q.status IN ['open', 'proposed'] AND q.id <> '01JDCYPHER00000000000000Q3' RETURN q.id AS id
MATCH (d:decision) WHERE d.due IS NULL RETURN d.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (n) WHERE n.title CONTAINS 'Launch' AND n.title ENDS WITH 'May' RETURN n.id AS id
MATCH (a)-[r:supports]->(b) WHERE r.confidence > 0.5 RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst, r.confidence AS c ORDER BY src, dst
MATCH (n) WHERE 'analyst' IN n.evidence_kinds AND size(n.evidence_kinds) = 1 RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (n) WHERE size(n.evidence_kinds) > 0 AND all(k IN n.evidence_kinds WHERE k = 'analyst') RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (q:question) WHERE q.status IN ['open', 'proposed'] AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (q)<-[:answers]-() } RETURN q.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (d:decision) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (q:question)-[:blocks]->(d) WHERE q.status = 'open' } RETURN d.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (q:question) OPTIONAL MATCH (q)<-[:answers]-(d) RETURN q.id AS qid, d.id AS answered_by ORDER BY qid
MATCH (d:decision)<-[:blocks]-(b) RETURN d.id AS id, count(*) AS n, min(b.id) AS first, max(b.id) AS last ORDER BY id
MATCH (o)-[r:supports|undercuts]->(t) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS sources, count(r) AS edges, sum(r.confidence) AS total, avg(r.confidence) AS mean
MATCH (d {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1'})<-[:blocks]-(b) WITH b ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1000 RETURN collect(b.id) AS ids
MATCH (b)-[:blocks]->(d) WITH d, count(*) AS blockers WHERE blockers >= 2 RETURN d.id AS id, blockers
MATCH (n)-[:blocks]->() RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS id ORDER BY id DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 2
UNWIND ['01JDCYPHER00000000000000D1', '01JDCYPHER00000000000000Q9'] AS x OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: x}) RETURN x, n.title AS title ORDER BY x
MATCH (d:decision) RETURN d.id AS id, CASE WHEN d.status = 'agreed' THEN 'settled' ELSE 'open' END AS state ORDER BY id
MATCH (n {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000P1'}) RETURN toLower(n.title) AS t, toUpper(n.status) AS s, coalesce(n.due, 'none') AS due, label(n) AS type

MATCH (a {id: '01JDCYPHER00000000000000Q1'})-[:blocks*]->(t) RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id ORDER BY id
